title: Parent-local mapping required
description: A split parent without its own mapping must not reuse a shared child's global compatibility row.

expected.message: missing parent-specific mapping for split parent

notes: The global child row is seeded by parent 0 and cannot supply parent 1's local node numbering.
The C++ regression checks both rejection and the strong no-partial-output guarantee.
The geometry fixture backend displays this contract but does not execute the C++ GoogleTest.
